sources.title: Graviton — 500B+ LLMs on a Mac Mini | AI for Everyone
sources.snippet: 72B Model on a Mac Mini Models that corporations run on server farms — Graviton runs on your desk. A 72B model compressed from 144 GB to 36 GB, streamed layer by layer so it never exceeds your RAM.

sources.title: GitHub - opengraviton/graviton
sources.snippet: The most powerful AI models shouldn't belong to a handful of corporations. Graviton is the open-source engine that breaks AI free from cloud monopolies and puts it on hardware you already own. A 72B model? Compressed to 36 GB, streamed layer by layer onto a Mac Mini.

sources.title: Fara-7B: An Efficient Agentic Model for Computer Use
